messages:
maria.g: Starting v2 rollout for /api/generate. We will stagger via proxy toggle: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 40m windows. Starting stage 1 now.

Deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-proxy: toggled v2-weight 5% for route /api/generate (deploy id deploy-20260320-7)

ben.s: quick checklist — header forward 'x-redwood-client-version' must be passed. Any clients still pinning to v1? @carla

carla: I added a compat shim to edge-proxy to map old param names (prompt_text -> prompt). Should be transparent but leaving pin option.

sam_k: putting smoke tests on the watch; will run cURL + payloads and compare top-3 token outputs for regressions.

sam_k: smoke curl:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'x-redwood-client-version: v2' \n  -d '{\'prompt\':\'hello\'}' https://api.redwood.ai/api/generate
```

oncall-sre: Observability: dashboards updated, alert 'v2-error-rate>1%' will page. I'll hold off on paging until 10% stable for 15m.

maria.g: If we see client errors with 400/422, we fall back for affected customers by header-pin: run:
```
# pin route for customer 1234 to v1
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' \n  https://console.redwood.ai/api/routes/pin \n  -d '{\'customer_id\':\'1234\',\'route\':\'/api/generate\',\'version\':\'v1\'}'
```

ben.s: Note: don't use full rollback unless latency/regressions > 10% or error spike. Prefer per-customer pin to reduce blast radius.

deploy-bot: [metric] v2 error-rate: 0.2% (5m)

carla: found one client lib that sends 'stop' instead of 'max_tokens' — shim fixed but I'll open PR to the lib owner. Leaving pin command ready.

maria.g: advancing to 20% in 20m if no alerts. @oncall-sre confirm when stable.

oncall-sre: looks green, latency +1ms, error-rate steady. go for it :rocket:

maria.g: rolling to 20% now.

Deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-proxy: v2-weight 20% for /api/generate

sam_k: running A/B evals on 50k reqs, will post summary if any quality diffs >1%.

ben.s: reminder — release notes update: add migration note about header and param rename. I'll draft.

maria.g: we keep this thread as the source of truth for decisions. If we need to rollback globally execute:
```
kubectl -n routing rollout undo deployment/proxy-deployment --to-revision=12
```

carla: ack. keeping customer-pin playbook ready in /docs/rollouts/pinning.md

maria.g: thanks team. next check in in 20m or oncall pings.
